title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Garden on 1980-05-12
lineage: MAC > Re-shelled > Nakamichi DR-8 > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > R8Brain > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 16; Transfer by Andrew F.
source: Matrix 70% sbd/30% aud; Soundboard source: SBD > Cassette Master > Reel > Dat (48k); Transfer Info: Dat (Sony R500) > Sound Devices 744T > Samplitude Professional v10.02 > Cool Edit Pro v2.0 > FLAC; All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller and Audience source: 2x Nakamichi CM300/CP1's > Sony TC-153SD > Maxell XLII's. Mics on stand, set up in center of upper balcony behind the stage, mics pointed at rear-facing P.A. Taped by Tim Friend.

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix recording of a high‑energy Boston Garden show featuring a frenetically paced Alabama Getaway, a standout Jack Straw, and a soaring China Rider jam.
ai_review.review: The tape captures a superbly clear matrix mix that sounds great for the Boston Garden venue. Reviewers love the frenetic pace of "Alabama Getaway," the powerful vocal moment on the north‑bound train verse in "Jack Straw," and the inspired China Rider jam, making this early recording a fan favorite.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed five‑star review praises both performance and sound quality; weighting favors the strong show with an excellent matrix source.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer notes the tape "sounds great" for Boston Garden, indicating clear, well‑balanced audio with no reported issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is described as frenetic and tightly paced, with high energy transitions especially on the Alabama Getaway and a memorable jam during China Rider.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His voice on the north‑bound train verse of Jack Straw is highlighted as a highlight.
